briefdescription.para: Default implementation of the hybrid query planner (EPIC 2.5).

detaileddescription.para: Implements DefaultQueryPlanner, the production-ready concrete subclass of QueryPlanner. Path selection follows the five canonical paths defined in docs/EPIC2_QUERY_PLANNER.md and ADR E2-003. Every decision carries an explicit FallbackReason; silent fallback is forbidden (ADR E2-005).

sect2.title: Path selection order (cheapest → most exact)

listitem.para: ANN Only — GPU Category A, non-truth-bearing retrieval
ANN + Tensor — fresh advisory tensor artifact + optional GPU matmul
ANN + Tensor + Exact Graph — quality-critical; graph-verified finalization
Direct Exact Graph — stale / missing artifact, or force_exact

sect2.para: Category C operations (ACL, provenance, transactions) are fail-closed: the planner never routes these to a GPU path, and any accidental attempt to select a GPU path for Category C input is rejected with FallbackReason::CategoryCSubpathDetected.
